comment: The skills Coddy carries inside its binary and hands to ${CODDY_HOME}/skills.
Vendored copies live in internal/skills/bundled/<name>/ and are refreshed by
scripts/vendor-bundled-skills.sh (make skills-vendor). Entries without a repo
are written in this repository and are never overwritten by the script.
The version of a skill is metadata.version in its SKILL.md frontmatter (a top-level version: still counts).
